For free YouTube transcription, your best options:

Easiest (no install):

YouTube's own captions — Click the "..." or "Show transcript" below the video. Free, instant, but quality depends on whether the creator added captions or relied on auto-generated ones (which are decent but miss punctuation/accents).
NoteGPT, Tactiq, or Glasp — Free browser tools/extensions that pull the transcript and often add AI summaries. Free tiers have limits.
Most accurate (needs setup):

OpenAI Whisper — Free, open-source, runs locally. Significantly better accuracy than YouTube auto-captions, handles accents and noise well. You download the audio (e.g., via yt-dlp) and run it. Requires comfort with command line. This is the gold standard for free.

Isang linggong puno ng makulay na selebrasyon, kultura, musika, palaro, pagkain, at pagkakaisa ang ating pagsasaluhan!

at marami pang iba!
